metadata.title: ReadyYet, repair and service tracking for your customers
metadata.description: Let your customers follow their repair or order online, without calling the shop and without creating an account.

hero.label: / Tracking for shops
hero.title: Your customers know when it's ready
hero.lede: Dropped off, in progress, ready: they follow their item online, with no call to the shop and no account to create.
hero.artLabel: A phone showing the tracking of an item left at a shop

steps.title: Three steps, no phone calls
steps.intro: You log the item at the counter, your customer follows it online and comes back when it's ready. No app to install, no account to create.

step1.title: You log the item
step1.text: At the counter, in seconds: the customer, the item, the expected date. They get their tracking link by email or QR code.

step2.title: Your customer follows along
step2.text: Every step you mark shows up on their tracking page. They know where their item is without calling you.

step3.title: They come back when it's ready
step3.text: The moment you set the Ticket to Ready, they get an email. They come to collect it, no wasted trip.
